item.title: [8] Flat-band-induced integer doping and phase transition in monolayer graphene
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: C. R. Woods, K. S. Novoselov

Authors: Z. Wang, C. Moulsdale, X. Guo, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Flat-band physics and structural transitions in moire graphene are highly relevant to electronic structure interests.

Tags: #material:graphene #topic:flat-band #topic:moire

Abstract: An architecture comprising monolayer graphene doubly aligned to bulk and monolayer hBN on either side shows a gate-tunable global structural phase transition between two stacking configurations, accompanied by flat-band-induced integer doping.

item.title: [10] Evidence for p-wave magnetism in electronic band structure of metallic EuSi
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Zhongkai Liu, Claudia Felser

Authors: Erjian Cheng, Yixing Yang, Yifan Gao, et al.

Score 10/10 A_MUST_READ

Why: author whitelist: Makoto Hashimoto

Tags: #photoemission #neutronscattering #bandstructure

Abstract: A combination of symmetry analysis, first-principles calculations, neutron scattering and photoemission spectroscopy shows p-wave magnetism in the near-Fermi-level electronic structure of stoichiometric metallic EuSi.

item.title: [7] Designing dislocation-driven polar vortex networks in twisted perovskites
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: J. M. G. Lastra, N. Pryds

Authors: W. Sandholt, N. Gauquelin, J. Mangeri, et al.

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Investigates topological textures and moire-like physics in twisted oxide interfaces.

Tags: #material:SrTiO3 #topic:topological-vortex #topic:moire

Abstract: Experimental and theoretical investigation of twisted freestanding SrTiO3 layers using various analytic methods from 4DSTEM to DFT reveal a long-range ordered screw dislocation pattern as well as topological polar vortex arrays in the interface plane.

item.title: [7] Low-power 2D CFETs using single-crystal high-κ dielectrics
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Jing-Kai Huang, Lain-Jong Li

Authors: Ni Yang, Ji Zhang, Yu-Cheng Lu, et al.

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Significant experiment on van der Waals heterostructures using 2D semiconductors and single-crystal dielectrics.

Tags: #2Dmaterials #semiconductors #heterostructures

Abstract: A transferable single-crystal anatase titanium dioxide dielectric enables high-quality interfaces with two-dimensional semiconductors, yielding near-ideal switching, low hysteresis and ultra-low-power complementary transistors and inverters.

item.title: [6] Fully integrated perovskite active polaritonic circuits
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Ilenia Viola, Daniele Sanvitto

Authors: Antonio Fieramosca, Vincenzo Ardizzone, Rosanna Mastria, et al.

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: Experimental study of integrated perovskite materials, relevant to broader 2D/materials interests.

Tags: #material #perovskite #photonics

Abstract: A fully integrated perovskite polaritonic circuit that brings the functionalities of fully integrated on-chip polaritonic systems simultaneously delivering room-temperature waveguide lasing, controllable optical routing and amplification together in a single-step-grown platform is shown.
